coverage: 2015-16 through 2024-25 (ten completed NBA seasons, ending-year key 2016–2025).
publisher: SportsDataverse, original collection pipeline of ESPN NBA APIs; not an official NBA-published dataset.
rebuild: python3 rebuild.py (cached); python3 rebuild.py --fetch (public source refresh); requires Python standard library and base R/Rscript.
rarityDefinition: Use games==82 team-seasons only for actual-win rarity: 240 rows, excluding 2019-20 and 2020-21. Empirical CDF or midrank can compare league-relative rarity; rarity is not latent ability. Sample maximum is not an absolute historical limit.
normalizedWinsDefinition: wins82 = 82*wins/(wins+losses). Retain actual wins and games. Pandemic seasons may be used as pace references but not treated as actual 82-game wins.
playoffDefinition: Higher final regular-season win percentage known before playoffs; exactly tied records excluded. Season_type==3, completed games only. Play-in (type5), incomplete/postponed entries excluded. Series grouped by season and unordered team IDs.
validations: 11,979 cleaned regular-season games; every team’s game count and wins exactly matches the standings snapshot
834 completed playoff games and150 series; exactly15/year; every winner has4wins and series length4–7
regularSeasonCleaning: Filter completed type2 records to official 30 team IDs for the season; exclude NBA Cup Championship finals (2024 and2025 ending-year seasons). Other Cup rounds count as regular-season games. All-Star games and incomplete rescheduling placeholders removed.
caveats: Record is an observed noisy proxy, not proof of underlying team quality.
Raw playoff rates combine actual matchup strength distributions,home advantage,injuries,rosters,and format; they do not identify causal effects of scoring frequency.
Postseason games within a series are dependent. Wilson intervals in summary are simple descriptive binomial intervals and should not be presented as fully cluster-adjusted uncertainty.
2020 NBA bubble has no real home court; ESPN neutral_site does not reliably mark these games. Explicit season/date override needed in any home-effect regression.
Home-split aggregate has11,974 classified home games versus11,979 actual regular-season games; avoid using the home-split count as total games.
Do not use final-season records to evaluate predictions of games within that same regular season: that introduces future information leakage. Final records are available for the subsequent playoffs.
